chunks: 272 - And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Dye with henna, for it clears the eyesight, causes hair to grow, gives a pleasant fragrance, and calms the wife."

key_terms.اِخْتَضِبُوا: Apply dye to the hair or body
key_terms.بِالْحِنَّاءِ: With henna, a natural dye used for beautification

ai.seo_question: What are the benefits of using henna according to a hadith of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله؟
ai.summary: This hadith encourages the use of henna as part of cleanliness and beautification. It presents henna as beneficial in appearance, bodily well-being, fragrance, and marital harmony.
